verdict.rationale: Highnote documents a Card Viewer SDK that embeds sensitive card data in your UI via iframes, so PCI-scoped data never flows through your servers or reaches page scripts. Its PCI page recommends the SDKs to reduce compliance requirements, versus full PCI compliance when you access sensitive data server-side. Missing for 10: explicit mention of PAN and CVV fields, documentation naming the resulting SAQ level (e.g., SAQ A rather than SAQ D), details of the ephemeral-key/token reveal flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
